lead.headline: Rice and Barkley are ruled out — and Jacobs, your new add, cannot play until Week 7
lead.deck: The lineup is still the projection lineup. Jacobs is reinstated Monday; Kamara is gone.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice and Saquon Barkley were both ruled out on Friday's reports. You dropped Alvin Kamara for Josh Jacobs this afternoon; the league takes Jacobs off the Commissioner's Exempt List on Monday, so he can play from Week 7 at Detroit — not Sunday — and further discipline is still possible. Jacksonville's Week 7 bye takes Lawrence, your only quarterback, with Tuten and Strange. This week, the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 119.5, against 85.9; Los Cachanillas still start the ruled-out Jalen Hurts. ESPN has you at 69%.
